00.name: Narrator
00.text: After chanelling Seat and Sour's magic you were able to rebuild the bridge.

02.name: Sour
02.text: That was very impressive lumberer. I was certain your body was going to be ripped in half.

04.name: Sweat
04.text: Let's not dwell in the past, the bridge is built so it's time to get going again.
